tasks.short: Analyze soil investigations and select management measures

steps.what: Read original soil investigation results; verify and capture site, sample, depth, date, units and comparison rules
inputs: Actual investigation results produced by field and laboratory staff
outputs: Checked source values and explicit comparison mapping

steps.what: Transfer exact checked investigation values into the soil assessment table
outputs: Assessment table with source references and missing values flagged

steps.what: Calculate explicit site and period differences and literal comparisons using the scientist's specified rules
outputs: Reproducible comparison values without management recommendations

steps.what: Analyze investigation results against original evidence and site conditions; determine measures to maintain or restore proper soil management
outputs: Human soil assessment and selected measures with limitations

steps.what: Write and check the actual soil assessment entry, selected measures and source references
outputs: Completed working assessment entry

steps.what: Save the assessment entry in its existing workspace
outputs: Saved assessment entry

tasks.design: Transfer checked investigation values into {SPREADSHEET} and calculate explicitly defined comparisons. The scientist interprets the results against original evidence and records actual soil-management measures in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Results are retyped and the same literal comparisons repeated across investigation tables.
tasks.enabler_now: Field mappings and explicit formulas can repeat these operations without proposing soil interventions.
tasks.still_hard: Sampling limits, site context and management consequences require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Select measures appropriate to the actual soil and land use.

ambition.what: Examine another relevant site comparison while retaining scientific assessment.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact result transfer and explicitly specified numerical comparisons can reduce repeated copying without determining soil-management measures.

assumptions: Representative desk assessment of completed investigations. Field and laboratory staff produce the original results in existing investigation work; that work remains unchanged. Source verification, unit checking, mapping and comparison-rule capture are counted fully in s1.

s1 supplies every value and rule consumed by s2-s3. Missing, incompatible or uncertain observations return to manual investigation. No ready-made clean feed, inferred threshold or automatic scientific interpretation is assumed.
Use native spreadsheet imports and formulas first. Already automated transfers or comparisons have no new gain. s4 includes original-source and calculation checking as well as selecting measures.

s5 is the actual working assessment, not an extra administrative report. Sending advice, authorising land work or implementing measures are distinct actual actions if required; no such action is hidden in the save, and no author self-approval is introduced.

Shares are provisional and independent of prompt priors. Gross 25+15=40; incremental upkeep 4 leaves net 36. Retained source, interpretation and writing total 59 already counted. Same-system save uses integer minimum share 1, fully retained with no saving.
unknowns: Which investigation transfers and comparisons are already native
Whether source formats support exact mapping
research_questions: Trace one completed soil assessment from original results to selected measures and identify actual retyping.

already_counted.description: Source capture, scientific interpretation and actual assessment writing remain in s1,s4,s5.

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings and comparison formulas beyond existing scientific checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound requires both manual transfers and repeated comparisons. If native imports already eliminate s2, only the 15 comparison points remain eligible; 4 upkeep leaves 11. If both are already native, re-estimate below this range.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct land-use investigations with explicit field records

steps.what: Inspect actual land-use maps, site records and access conditions for the investigation
inputs: Existing maps and site records produced by mapping and land-management staff
outputs: Verified site context in the existing geographic information system

steps.what: Develop the actual land-use survey or investigation design, observation definitions and field route
outputs: Human investigation design and explicit site identifiers

steps.what: Conduct the land-use investigation in the field, observe conditions and capture actual measurements and field notes
outputs: Actual field observations, measurements and contemporaneous notes

steps.what: Write and check the land-use investigation record from actual field notes, using native site-identifier and reference reuse
inputs: Actual field notes and measurements from s3
outputs: Completed investigation record in the existing geographic information system

steps.what: Save the completed investigation record in that geographic information system
outputs: Saved investigation record

steps.what: Assess what the actual investigation findings imply for later corrective action planning
inputs: Original notes and completed investigation record
outputs: Human assessment of implications and limitations

tasks.design: Keep study design and field investigation with the scientist. Configure the existing geographic information system, {OTHER}, to reuse verified site identifiers while the scientist writes and checks actual observations; {DOCS} holds the design and interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Field records repeat site identifiers and references already established in the investigation design.
tasks.enabler_now: Native geographic forms can reuse exact identifiers without inventing land conditions.
tasks.still_hard: Field access, observation quality and interpreting land use require physical and scientific work.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise conditions a form or map does not capture.

ambition.what: No additional field capacity is assumed from a small reduction in repeated record fields.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect field-record access and actual forms

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native geographic record forms can reuse site identifiers while scientists retain field observations and their interpretation.

assumptions: Representative field-investigation episode with an actual investigation record, not a universal duty mix. Mapping and land-management staff produce existing records in ordinary work; scientist inspection and actual study design remain in s1-s2.

s3 counts all actual measurement and contemporaneous note capture. s4 separately counts writing and checking the real investigation record; its reduction applies only to exact site and reference reuse. No automatic observation extraction or free digital measurements are assumed.

s2 supplies the site identifiers reused in s4; missing identifiers or incompatible maps require manual resolution. Existing form defaults give no additional saving. All descriptions and measurement verification remain human.

Corrective plan development and implementation are subsequent actual work, not automatically delivered by an investigation. The task's informing assessment remains in s6. No report or notice is invented after a field visit; if an actual separate report or send is required, add its real work and authority before estimating that episode.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 19*0.20=3.8; upkeep 1 leaves net 2.8. Retained s1,s2,s3,s4,s6 labour is 95.2 already counted. Same-system save is minimum share 1, fully retained and ungated with no saving.
unknowns: Whether native forms already reuse site identifiers
Actual field-record and later reporting requirements
research_questions: Watch one land-use investigation and distinguish measurement, field notes, final record entry and interpretation.

already_counted.description: Site preparation, study design, field capture, investigation-record checking and interpretation remain in s1-s4,s6.

incremental.description: Maintain site-field reuse beyond ordinary investigation record checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound assumes repeated site fields consume one fifth of actual record-entry effort. If existing native forms already supply these identifiers, there is no additional reduction and no new configuration upkeep is incurred. Fieldwork and scientific interpretation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read actual local-government assistance requests and current program records using native case filters
inputs: Current program records from program staff
outputs: Verified request context and existing commitments

steps.what: Discuss actual assistance needs, constraints and progress with local-government and program staff
outputs: Actual coordination discussion and clarified needs

steps.what: Coordinate technical, financial or administrative assistance program priorities and actual response responsibilities within delegated authority
inputs: Actual program constraints and delegated authority
outputs: Human program coordination choices and unresolved matters

steps.what: Write and check the actual program coordination work plan, reusing exact request references and existing project fields
outputs: Completed internal coordination work plan

steps.what: Save the work plan in its existing project workspace without sending notices or releasing funds
outputs: Saved work plan

tasks.design: Use native request views and field reuse in {PROJECT} to support the scientist's actual program coordination. The scientist discusses needs and writes the actual work plan with {DOCS}; financial or implementation authority is not inferred from that plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program staff search repeated request context and recopy references into coordination plans.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project filters and record links can reuse existing context without allocating assistance automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Local constraints, resource priorities and actual delegated powers require human coordination.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve practical needs and responsibilities with the people implementing assistance.

ambition.what: Consider another eligible assistance request when genuine coordination capacity permits.

reach.task: Implement the actual agreed assistance work
reach.learn: The real constraints and responsibilities recorded by coordination

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect actual request access and notification behaviour

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project filters and native record references can assist assistance-program coordination while priorities and resource decisions remain human.

assumptions: Representative coordination episode with an actual working plan; the broad statement also includes implementation, which needs its own observed duty mix. Local-government and program staff produce actual requests and existing records in normal work. Their effort stays unchanged; focal reading and discussion are counted in s1-s2.

s4 uses only exact fields and references actually present in s1 and choices made in s3. Missing information remains manual follow-up. No clean request feed, automatic eligibility decision or free transcription is assumed.

The actual written work plan is separate from conversation. Native links reduce literal reference copying, not the scientist's writing and checking of responsibilities. Existing filters and links carry no new gain.

Project saving has notifications disabled. A real assistance commitment, allocation, payment, instruction notice or external reply is a separate actual action with its existing authority and final-version gate. Do not apply this coordination estimate to those implementation duties without adding their actual work. No invented self-approval is used.

Shares are provisional independent of prompt prior. Gross 20*0.20+24*0.25=10; upkeep 2 leaves net 8. Retained s1-s4 labour is 89 already counted. Save share 1 is the integer minimum for negligible active effort and is fully retained with no saving.
unknowns: Actual coordination versus implementation duty mix
Which native views and work-plan links already exist
research_questions: Trace one assistance request through discussion, actual work-plan entry and any separately authorised implementation actions.

already_counted.description: Actual request reading, program discussions, coordination decisions and work-plan writing remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain case filters and work-plan links beyond existing program coordination checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound combines reduced request navigation and exact work-plan reference reuse. Where references are already linked, only the 4 request-navigation points remain; 2 upkeep leaves 2. No reduction is claimed for discussion or allocation judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Respond to wetland jurisdiction questions and complaints

steps.what: Read the actual wetland question or complaint and existing case facts using native case lookup
inputs: Actual question or complaint provided by the requester
outputs: Verified question, location reference and unresolved facts

steps.what: Find and read the current authoritative wetland information pages and case references using native topic and jurisdiction filters
inputs: Actual current information pages maintained by responsible agency staff
outputs: Exact sources and passages relevant to the question

steps.what: Determine what information or clarification can actually be provided on wetland jurisdiction; identify contested or unresolved matters for the responsible authority
inputs: Original authoritative passages and case facts
outputs: Human interpretation and actual limits of the response

steps.what: Respond to the requester in the actual telephone conversation, explain wetland jurisdiction information and clarify limits or the appropriate authority
outputs: Actual spoken response and clarification

steps.what: Write and check the actual case-handling entry describing the conversation and unresolved question
outputs: Completed case-handling entry

steps.what: Save the completed case-handling entry in the existing case workspace
outputs: Saved case entry

tasks.design: Use native case filters in {HELPDESK} and source filters in {DOCS} to help the scientist find the actual wetland information. The scientist interprets it, gives the real telephone response through {TELEPHONY}, and separately records actual case handling.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated case and authoritative-source navigation takes time before a clarification can be given.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views can retrieve existing case and information references without generating a jurisdiction decision.
tasks.still_hard: Contested boundaries, incomplete facts and binding jurisdiction decisions require the actual responsible authority.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what the sources establish and recognise when the question exceeds delegated authority.

ambition.what: No automatic determination or additional service commitment is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to confirm current source ownership and case access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case and topic retrieval can assist public-information responses while interpretation and clarification remain human.

assumptions: Representative telephone information-response episode with an actual required case entry; not every complaint is routine, and this estimate cannot be extrapolated to contested determinations or formal correspondence. Requesters supply questions; case staff and responsible agency owners maintain existing facts and authoritative pages in ordinary work. Focal source reading and interpretation remain counted.

s1 supplies the actual question and location reference used in s2; all pages are read by the scientist. Missing or outdated sources require manual investigation. No ready-made jurisdiction classification, free question transcription or generated legal guidance is assumed.

Use existing native views first; already available retrieval gives no additional gain. The reductions affect navigation only, not substantive reading. s3 makes no binding decision outside the scientist's actual authority.

s4 is the actual human telephone conversation, with no automated call, written send or formal determination hidden inside it. A formal written answer or referral send must have its real completed version, actual authority and separate action step if required. The case entry is written after the conversation, not prefilled as completed.

s5 is conditional on an actual case-entry requirement; do not invent it after an informal question. A same-system save is ungated, with no self-approval and no saving. Its share 1 is the schema minimum for negligible effort.
Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 20*0.20+20*0.30=10; upkeep 2 leaves net 8. Retained s1-s5 labour is 89 already counted.
unknowns: Current source ownership and existing native filters
research_questions: Observe a real wetland question and separate case lookup, authoritative reading, spoken clarification and required case entry.

already_counted.description: Case reading, authoritative-source reading, interpretation, actual conversation and case entry remain in s1-s5.

incremental.description: Maintain source filters and detect stale source references beyond ordinary case checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound requires navigation reductions in both case and source lookup. Where source filters already exist, only 4 case-navigation points remain eligible; 2 upkeep leaves 2. Formal or contested jurisdiction work needs its own observed work estimate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Responsible wetland information and jurisdiction authorities
skills_to_grow: Explicit soil-result mappings and comparison rules
role.ambitious_version: A conservation scientist who spends less effort recopying evidence while retaining field observation, management judgement and direct public explanation.
